headline: Nine Months In, Interest Continues in SCE's Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program
summary: ROSEMEAD, Calif., July 31, 2026--Nine months after launching its Wildfire Recovery Compensation Program, Southern California Edison today announced that community members directly impacted by the Eaton Fire continue to seek compensation and receive payments through the voluntary program. More than 4,000 claims have been submitted through the program. More than 2,400 claimants have been paid, with many more in the pipeline once they finalize their settlements.
